intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}, but they are very different institutions. This page compares the recorded fees we hold and flags what should not be treated as a flagship doctoral fee, using official sites opened in {{year}}.

GITAM University vs IIM Visakhapatnam is a private university against a public Indian Institute of Management. The short title says only 'Indian Institute of Management'; the campus in the table is IIM Visakhapatnam.

sections.heading: GITAM University vs IIM Visakhapatnam for Ph.D: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IIM Visakhapatnam if you want a public IIM doctorate, including the listed Executive Ph.D option, after you confirm the official FPM or Ph.D fee notice rather than relying only on our executive fee row.

Choose GITAM University if you want a private-university doctorate in the listed engineering and biotechnology areas, with a recorded tuition of ₹30,000 a year, after you confirm supervision and the official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For GITAM University we hold ₹30,000 as tuition for one year on doctoral rows in information technology, electronics, electrical, civil engineering and biotechnology. That is a year figure, not a confirmed multi-year official total.

For IIM Visakhapatnam the only fee row on this page is ₹2.50 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for the Executive Ph.D. That is not the same as a regular residential doctoral or FPM fee, and we have no regular Ph.D fee row.
Do not treat the executive fee as the default IIM doctoral cost. Recheck the official IIM Visakhapatnam doctoral brochure and GITAM's Ph.D notice before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We have no Ph.D placement row for either side, so this page cannot quote an average or highest package.
Doctoral outcomes depend on the thesis, stipend and the job you seek after. Ask both doctoral offices about recent completions rather than looking for an MBA-style package.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam mapped on this page. IIM doctoral admissions typically use a test or a valid CAT, GRE or similar score plus an interview; GITAM will have its own doctoral process. Follow the official notifications.
The research areas differ. GITAM's listed rows are in engineering and biotechnology. IIM Visakhapatnam lists a Doctor of Philosophy and an Executive Ph.D, which is a management doctorate.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, so a local student can visit them without leaving the city.
IIM Visakhapatnam is a public management institute. GITAM is a private university with a much wider campus mix. The research community will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IIM Visakhapatnam if a public IIM doctorate is what you want, and you have the official regular or executive fee from the institute brochure, not only our executive row.
Pick GITAM University if the listed engineering or biotechnology doctorate and the recorded ₹30,000 year tuition fit your plan, after official confirmation.
These are not interchangeable Ph.D programmes. Match the research area first, then the fee notice.

faqs.question: Is the IIM Visakhapatnam Ph.D fee ₹2.50 lakh?
faqs.answer: That ₹2.50 lakh row is a Total Fees year figure for the Executive Ph.D, not a confirmed regular doctoral or FPM total. We have no regular Ph.D fee row. Use the official IIM Visakhapatnam brochure.

faqs.question: What Ph.D fee is on record for GITAM University?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹30,000 as tuition for one year on several doctoral rows in engineering and biotechnology. That is not a confirmed multi-year official total.

faqs.question: Are doctoral placements listed?
faqs.answer: No. We have no Ph.D placement row for either side. Ask the doctoral offices about stipends and recent completions.

faqs.question: Is IIM Visakhapatnam a government institute?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our records list IIM Visakhapatnam as a public institute and GITAM University as a private university, both in Visakhapatnam.

faqs.question: Do these Ph.D programmes cover the same subjects?
faqs.answer: No. GITAM's listed rows are in engineering and biotechnology. IIM Visakhapatnam lists a Doctor of Philosophy and an Executive Ph.D, which is a management doctorate.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Visakhapatnam?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are recorded in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
